findings.title: Reconnect does not reload a stable workspace gateway
findings.state: ready Windows minimized after a disconnected guest display
findings.expected: Reconnect reopens the current environment connection without stopping or relaunching the VM.
findings.observed: The control sets connection to data.url. When the gateway URL is unchanged the iframe remains the same loaded document. Independent synthetic frame count stayed1 before and after clicking Reconnect.
findings.consequence: A trainee with a stuck or disconnected embedded guest cannot recover via the offered recovery action.
findings.reproduce: Launch fixture desktop; minimize; click Reconnect while gateway returns the same URL. Observe frame navigation/load count and guest document remain unchanged.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/features/live/AnalystTools.tsx Reconnect handler; independent-v1/probe.cjs and browser-observations.json reconnect.loads_before=1,loads_after=1. Native suite18/18 passes because it asserts preservation on minimize but does not exercise explicit reconnect.
findings.remedy: Explicitly reload or rekey the existing iframe on Reconnect while preserving its gateway URL, exercise and VM. Ordinary minimize/resume must continue preserving the frame.
findings.retest: Assert minimize/resume causes exactly one frame load, explicit Reconnect causes a second load at the same URL, repeated reconnect works, and no new VM launch POST occurs. Exercise error and retry states.
findings.resolution_evidence: Current source uses frameRevision iframe key, incremented only by explicit Reconnect. Independent v2 probe rendered guest1,guest2,guest3 at unchanged gateway URL, counts1→2→3; intervening minimize/resume held2, launchPOSTcount1. Native regression and failed503 recovery tests pass.

findings.title: Assigned training starts without its company briefing
findings.state: new assigned practice or assessment attempt
findings.expected: Before starting training, present the assigned scenario company briefing once and let the learner explicitly launch afterward.
findings.observed: LearnerDesk Start assignment directly calls POST/assignments/:id/start then navigates Monitor. Browser probe recorded0briefing panels before click,1startPOST,0confirmation dialogs, immediate exercise route.
findings.consequence: A first-time assigned trainee begins the scenario without role, authority, normal work or response policy. Assessment/independent clocks can begin before this necessary orientation.
findings.reproduce: Return one unused assignment from fixture assignments; open My training; click Start assignment. Observe immediate start request/navigation with no pre-launch company briefing.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/features/live/TrainingDesk.tsx:60-64,141; independent-v2/probe.cjs and browser-observations.json assignment result; assignment-before-1440.png and assignment-after-1440.png.
findings.remedy: Load the assigned scenario briefing and show a pre-start confirmation before dispatching the existing assignment start request. Keep instructor-fixed scenario/mode/assistance, attempt enforcement and server-owned timing. Do not repeatedly inject briefing into live investigation.
findings.retest: For first assigned coached, independent and assessment attempts, assert no startPOST until the expanded briefing is shown and confirmed; cancel makes no start call, failure retains retry, confirm uses assignment endpoint, and later live pages expose only the reference.
